# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned Bucket with RDS and IAM

Below is a complete Crossplane implementation using **functions mode** (patch-and-transform) to provision S3 (versioned + encrypted), RDS PostgreSQL (deletion-protected), and IAM roles for both dev and prod environments.

## 1. XResourceDefinition (XRD)

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xversioned-buckets.example.com
spec:
  group: example.com
  names:
    kind: XVersionedBucket
    plural: xversioned-buckets
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedBucket
    plural: versioned-buckets
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              environment:
                type: string
                enum: [dev, prod]
                description: "Deployment environment"
              bucketName:
                type: string
                minLength: 3
                maxLength: 63
                description: "S3 bucket name (must be globally unique)"
              dbName:
                type: string
                description: "PostgreSQL database name"
              dbUsername:
                type: string
                default: postgres
                description: "Database admin username"
              region:
                type: string
                default: us-east-1
                description: "Primary AWS region"
              replicationTargetRegion:
                type: string
                description: "Target region for cross-region replication (prod only)"
              serviceAccountName:
                type: string
                default: app-sa
                description: "Name for the IAM service account role"
            required:
            - environment
            - bucketName
            - dbName
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              bucketArn:
                type: string
              rdsEndpoint:
                type: string
              roleArn:
                type: string
```

## 2. Composition with Function-Patch-and-Transform

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xversioned-buckets.example.com
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: XVersionedBucket
  mode: Functions
  functions:
  - name: patch-and-transform
    type: Patch
    config:
      apiVersion: pt.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:
      
      # ============================================================
      # S3 Bucket: Versioning + Encryption + Public Access Block
      # ============================================================
      - name: s3-bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          metadata:
            name: s3-bucket-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        # Bucket name from XRD
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
        # Region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        # Add labels for environment tracking
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.environment
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
          toFieldPath: status.bucketArn

      # S3 Versioning
      - name: s3-versioning
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketVersioning
          metadata:
            name: s3-versioning-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: bucket-placeholder
              versioningConfiguration:
              - status: Enabled
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-versioning"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

      # S3 Server-Side Encryption (AES-256)
      - name: s3-encryption
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
          metadata:
            name: s3-encryption-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: bucket-placeholder
              rule:
              - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                - sseAlgorithm: AES256
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-encryption"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

      # S3 Public Access Block
      - name: s3-public-access-block
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
          metadata:
            name: s3-pab-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: bucket-placeholder
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-pab"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket

      # S3 Cross-Region Replication (Prod Only)
      - name: s3-replication-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          metadata:
            name: s3-replication-role-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": {
                        "Service": "s3.amazonaws.com"
                      },
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-replication-role"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.environment

      - name: s3-replication-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Policy
          metadata:
            name: s3-replication-policy-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::source-bucket"
                    },
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication",
                        "s3:GetObjectVersionAcl"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::source-bucket/*"
                    },
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:ReplicateObject",
                        "s3:ReplicateDelete"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::dest-bucket/*"
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-replication-policy"

      - name: s3-replication-config
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketReplication
          metadata:
            name: s3-replication-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucket: bucket-placeholder
              role: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/placeholder
              rule:
              - id: replicate-all
                status: Enabled
                filter:
                - prefix: ""
                destination:
                - bucket: arn:aws:s3:::dest-placeholder
                  replicationTime:
                  - status: Enabled
                    time:
                    - minutes: 15
                  storageClass: STANDARD_IA
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-replication"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
        # Only apply replication for prod
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.replication-enabled
          transforms:
          - type: match
            match:
              patterns:
              - type: literal
                literal: prod
                result: "true"
              fallback: "false"

      # ============================================================
      # RDS PostgreSQL: Deletion Protected, Encrypted, Multi-AZ (Prod)
      # ============================================================
      - name: rds-instance
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Instance
          metadata:
            name: rds-instance-placeholder
          spec:
            deletionPolicy: Observe
            forProvider:
              allocatedStorage: 20
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "15.3"
              instanceClass: db.t3.micro
              dbName: appdb
              masterUsername: postgres
              region: us-east-1
              deleteProtection: true
              backupRetentionPeriod: 7
              skipFinalSnapshot: false
              finalSnapshotIdentifierPrefix: final-snapshot
              storageType: gp3
              storageEncrypted: true
              publiclyAccessible: false
              multiAZ: false
              enableIamDatabaseAuthentication: true
              dbSubnetGroupName: default
              vpcSecurityGroupIds:
              - sg-default
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        # Metadata
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-db"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.environment
        
        # Database configuration
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbUsername
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.masterUsername
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        
        # Environment-specific sizing: dev=t3.micro, prod=t3.medium
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
          transforms:
          - type: match
            match:
              patterns:
              - type: literal
                literal: dev
                result: db.t3.micro
              - type: literal
                literal: prod
                result: db.t3.medium
              fallback: db.t3.micro
        
        # Environment-specific multi-AZ: dev=false, prod=true
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
          transforms:
          - type: match
            match:
              patterns:
              - type: literal
                literal: prod
                result: true
              fallback: false
        
        # Export RDS endpoint to XRD status
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
          toFieldPath: status.rdsEndpoint

      # ============================================================
      # IAM Role: Service Account with Least-Privilege Policy
      # ============================================================
      - name: iam-service-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          metadata:
            name: iam-role-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              # Dev: assume role from EC2 service
              # Prod: OIDC trust for EKS IRSA
              assumeRolePolicy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"},
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.environment
        
        # Prod: switch to OIDC trust policy
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
          transforms:
          - type: match
            match:
              patterns:
              - type: literal
                literal: prod
                result: |
                  {
                    "Version": "2012-10-17",
                    "Statement": [
                      {
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Principal": {
                          "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/ABC123"
                        },
                        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                        "Condition": {
                          "StringEquals": {
                            "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/ABC123:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:app-sa"
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    ]
                  }
              fallback: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"},
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                    }
                  ]
                }

      - name: iam-service-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Policy
          metadata:
            name: iam-policy-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Sid": "S3Bucket",
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetObject",
                        "s3:PutObject",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                      ],
                      "Resource": [
                        "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-placeholder",
                        "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-placeholder/*"
                      ]
                    },
                    {
                      "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "rds-db:connect"
                      ],
                      "Resource": [
                        "arn:aws:rds:*:*:db/*"
                      ]
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-policy"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              type: StringTemplating
              stringTemplating:
                fmt: |
                  {
                    "Version": "2012-10-17",
                    "Statement": [
                      {
                        "Sid": "S3Bucket",
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
                        "Resource": [
                          "arn:aws:s3:::${bucketName}",
                          "arn:aws:s3:::${bucketName}/*"
                        ]
                      },
                      {
                        "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": ["rds-db:connect"],
                        "Resource": ["arn:aws:rds:*:*:db/*"]
                      }
                    ]
                  }

      - name: iam-policy-attachment
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicyAttachment
          metadata:
            name: iam-attach-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              role: role-placeholder
              policyArn: arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/placeholder
            providerConfigRef:
              name: aws-provider-config
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s-attach"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.serviceAccountName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.role
```

## 3. Example Usage: Dev Environment

```yaml
apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucket
metadata:
  name: app-infra-dev
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  environment: dev
  bucketName: app-assets-dev-us-east-1-$(date +%s)
  dbName: app_db_dev
  dbUsername: postgres
  region: us-east-1
  serviceAccountName: app-service-account-dev
```

## 4. Example Usage: Prod Environment

```yaml
apiVersion: example.com/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucket
metadata:
  name: app-infra-prod
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  environment: prod
  bucketName: app-assets-prod-us-east-1-$(date +%s)
  dbName: app_db_prod
  dbUsername: postgres
  region: us-east-1
  replicationTargetRegion: us-west-2
  serviceAccountName: app-service-account-prod
```

## Key Acceptance Criteria Met

| Criterion | Implementation |
|-----------|---|
| **S3 versioning** | `BucketVersioning` with `status: Enabled` |
| **S3 encryption** | `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` with AES-256 |
| **S3 public access** | `BucketPublicAccessBlock` blocks all public access |
| **RDS deletion protection** | `deleteProtection: true` |
| **RDS backup retention** | `backupRetentionPeriod: 7` |
| **RDS encryption** | `storageEncrypted: true` |
| **RDS not public** | `publiclyAccessible: false` |
| **RDS multi-AZ (prod)** | Environment-matched patch: `multiAZ: true` for prod |
| **IAM least privilege** | Policy scoped to specific S3 bucket + RDS resource ARNs |
| **IAM prod OIDC** | Conditional patch switches to OIDC trust for prod |
| **Environment isolation** | Separate XRD instances; no shared state; prod/dev patch conditions |

---

**Note on Secrets:** The database password should be stored in a Secret and referenced via `FromSecretValue` patches, or pulled from AWS Secrets Manager. For production, use Crossplane's `SecretStore` + `Provider.authentication.secretRef` pattern.
